title: Martinique (Bouillé) letters 'chiffrée non décryptée': 17 Sep 1778 and 5 Dec 1778 with ciphered enclosures
correspondents: Governor of Martinique (marquis de Bouillé) → minister of the Navy
shelfmark: Archives nationales d'outre-mer (Aix-en-Provence), COL C8 A 77, f° 88 (no. 238, 17 Sep 1778) and f° 101 (no. 259, 5 Dec 1778)
status: ANOM calendar states explicitly 'Lettre chiffrée non décryptée' and 'Lettre et pièces jointes chiffrées non décryptées'. The same volume holds the minister's ciphered minutes (ff. 31, 43) and the Martinique series COL C8 A 78-81 has 20 more 'chiffrée' letters of 1779-82. Not on DECODE. Checked 28 Oct 2026: Viewed 28 Oct 2026 in the FranceArchives IIIF viewer: COL C8 A 77 f. 88 (17 Sep 1778) is a one-page numeric cipher letter, about 150 numbers, clear salutation only, no interlinear decipherment; calendar says 'non décryptée'. Images online. Repo mercier1761 key (C8 A 64) is the obvious first test. Key status 28 Oct 2026 (targets/martinique1778): the sibling mercier1761 key does not fit (28 groups exceed its maximum, output nonsense); the Bouillé code is a larger third code. A contemporary interlinear decipherment sits on C8 A 78 f.123 (11 Oct 1779) and the same code runs through the 1778-79 letters; with it the key has 123 values and 68% of this letter is valued (read in part, a monthly troop return). Not at the read bar.
why: Martinique at the opening of France's war for American independence (1778): Bouillé's own cipher, undeciphered at the time.
verify: Test the mercier1761 nomenclator, then anneal.
